entities.name: Evangelical Church in Zagreb
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Evangelical Church in Zagreb is an Evangelical Lutheran Church located in centre of Zagreb, Croatia. The church was originally built in period from 1882 until 1884. The building is a free-standing single-nave neo-Gothic church.
